llm_judge_details.justification: The topology includes all essential 5G core VNFs (NRF, AMF, SMF, UPF) plus optional functions, satisfying a simple standalone core though it is slightly over‑provisioned. VNF types, interfaces and inter‑connections follow 3GPP TS 23.501 conventions, so correctness is high. Resource requests are modest and appropriate for a test environment, with the UPF sized a bit larger but still reasonable. A single eMBB slice is defined even though the intent did not specify slicing; this adds unnecessary detail but does not break alignment, yielding a moderate score. SLA targets (50 ms latency, 1 Gbps throughput, 99.9 % availability) are realistic for a test core, though perhaps stricter than strictly needed.
